title: 阪神JFの後に・不屈たる様

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Victory was beyond my grasp… What an utter disappointment.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: But this proves the current state of my abilities. I need to accept the reality before me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Knowing how to act even when things go awry is an important skill in its own right.
choice_data_list: Since people are always watching, right?
Since people are always watching, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Exactly. I will use this loss to propel me forward.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: So I ask that you don't forget how to conduct yourself either. You are my trainer, after all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: President…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Apologies for the intrusion. I know you must be tired. But I let my curiosity get the better of me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry you had to see such an awful display. I should have done better.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: No need to apologize. Your conversation just now was explanation enough.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: The Empress remains undaunted…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It appears my worries were unfounded.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Thank you. Such praise is more than I deserve.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Come what may, I will do my utmost to live up to the faith you have placed in me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Very good. I look forward to the rest of your classic year. Now then, I shall take my leave.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
choice_data_list: Let's head back and review today's race.
Let's head back and review today's race.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Agreed.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: There's no point in wasting time mulling over what could have been. Let's go—to ensure our next victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing the fire in Air Groove's eyes rekindled, I vow to use what we learned today to win next time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite our loss at the Hanshin J.F., the world at large continues to watch Air Groove with fervor.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The media is awash for days with debate as to what path she'll take in her classic year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Realizing I should talk to Air Groove, I head to her dorm.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Oh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On my way, I bump into Air Groove at the academy gates.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Well, this saves me some time.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I was about to contact you. I have something I wish to discuss.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I wanted to talk to you too.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh, very well. Let's move somewhere more appropriate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I tell Air Groove I want to discuss her upcoming races.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: We're doing the Tiara tour. I aim to become a Triple Tiara champion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She speaks without a shade of hesitation, her voice full of determination.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Tiara tour is made up of the Oka Sho, the Japanese Oaks, and the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All three are renowned G1 races. A victory in any one of them is enough to secure fame for years to come.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And the title of Triple Tiara champion is a high honor granted only to those who come out on top in all three races.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Umamusume who run in the Tiara tour are more than just strong—they are also virtuous and glamorous.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: To prove that I belong among their number, I'll need more than just strength.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I need to enrapture every pair of eyes in attendance. I need to be a shining beacon that all Umamusume aspire toward.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That is my ideal—the essence of what it means to be Empress.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: As such, attempting the Triple Tiara is a necessary step toward my end goal.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: On top of that, the Japanese Oaks is a vital part of my roots.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Of the three races, I absolutely must stand on top at the Japanese Oaks if I wish to even dream of calling myself Empress.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove's roots… She must be referring to how her mother shot to fame after winning the Japanese Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: When I announce my intent to pursue the Tiara tour, my fans will immediately expect me to follow in my mother's footsteps and conquer the Japanese Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I have no way of knowing the weight of the burden she bears. All I can do is provide her with the best training I can.
